items.name: camera-dolly-zoom
items.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
items.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

items.description: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

items.name: physical-exit
items.title: Physical Exit
items.description: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.

items.name: press-ripple
items.title: Press Ripple
items.description: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with ink ripple rings, then exits off-stage while the pressed state holds.

items.name: pull-back-reveal
items.title: Pull Back Reveal
items.description: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to Refresh
items.description: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.

items.name: push-in
items.title: Push In
items.description: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.

items.name: radial-surround
items.title: Radial Surround
items.description: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

items.name: rgb-glitch-text
items.title: RGB Glitch Text
items.description: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.

items.name: rubber-band-bumper
items.title: Rubber Band Bumper
items.description: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

items.name: scan-band
items.title: Scan Band
items.description: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.

items.name: scramble-reveal
items.title: Scramble Reveal
items.description: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.

items.name: screen-flow-carousel
items.title: Screen Flow Carousel
items.description: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

items.name: scroll-camera-story
items.title: Scroll Camera Story
items.description: A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.

items.name: scroll-feed
items.title: Scroll Feed
items.description: A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.

items.name: segmentation-flood
items.title: Segmentation Flood
items.description: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal

items.name: settings-toggle-flow
items.title: Settings Toggle Flow
items.description: A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback

items.name: shared-axis-y
items.title: Shared Axis Y
items.description: Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.

items.name: shared-axis-z
items.title: Shared Axis Z
items.description: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

items.name: sheet-spring-up
items.title: Sheet Spring-Up
items.description: A bottom sheet rushes up from below the frame on a real spring sampled frame by frame from reference footage, overshooting its resting place and settling back without an approximated ease

items.name: shimmer-sweep
items.title: Shimmer Sweep
items.description: Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask — ideal for AI accents and premium reveals

items.name: signup-flow
items.title: Signup Flow
items.description: A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button

items.name: simulated-cursor
items.title: Simulated Cursor
items.description: A lightweight cursor pointer and click pulse for product walkthroughs and agent UI demos

items.name: skeleton-reveal
items.title: Skeleton Reveal
items.description: A skeleton loader transition that pulses, then cross-fades into content

items.name: slit-scan-reveal
items.title: Slit Scan Reveal
items.description: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

items.name: slot-machine-roll
items.title: Slot Machine Roll
items.description: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

items.name: social-proof-card
items.title: Social Proof Card
items.description: The app-store close as one mountable scene: wordmark, five stars, a proof line, three feature icons and a CTA capsule build in a quiet stagger and hold - measured from reference ad footage. For an animated star sweep use star-rating-fill; for a quote card use testimonial-proof-card; for a bare lockup use cta-lockup

items.name: soft-blob-touch
items.title: Soft Blob Touch
items.description: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

items.name: soft-blur-in
items.title: Soft Blur In
items.description: A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts

items.name: split-tilt-cards
items.title: Split Tilt Cards
items.description: Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card with a scripted cursor spotlight and lit border.

items.name: spring-pop
items.title: Spring Pop
items.description: A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.

items.name: spring-stack-shuffle
items.title: Spring Stack Shuffle
items.description: A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.

items.name: stagger-cascade
items.title: Stagger Cascade
items.description: A responsive grid of tile cards that fades and travels into place with an evenly spaced per-item GSAP stagger. The ordered cascade is the only visual mechanic.

items.name: stagger-lattice
items.title: Stagger Lattice
items.description: A staggered grid reveal inspired by Anime.js v4 stagger utilities, implemented with GSAP for HyperFrames.

items.name: staggered-fade-up
items.title: Staggered Fade Up
items.description: Words fade in and slide up one after another with configurable delay.

items.name: star-rating-fill
items.title: Star Rating Fill
items.description: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

items.name: state-chip-rail
items.title: State Chip Rail
items.description: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.

items.name: sticky-mock-swap
items.title: Sticky Mock Swap
items.description: A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.

items.name: stitched-text-draw
items.title: Stitched Text Draw
items.description: Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.

items.name: stop-motion-cadence
items.title: Stop Motion Cadence
items.description: The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.

items.name: store-badge-lockup
items.title: Store Badge Lockup
items.description: Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Words arrive the way an AI answer streams - in uneven bursts on a measured token rhythm, each word landing grey and inking to full colour - rather than the even tick of a typewriter

items.name: strikethrough-replace
items.title: Strikethrough Replace
items.description: Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success Check
items.description: A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur

items.name: svg-line-draw-loader
items.title: SVG Line Draw Loader
items.description: An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.

items.name: svg-mask-reveal
items.title: SVG Mask Reveal
items.description: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

items.name: svg-stroke-trace
items.title: SVG Stroke Trace
items.description: An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.

items.name: swipe-rail
items.title: Swipe Rail
items.description: A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.

items.name: tabs-slide-indicator
items.title: Tabs Slide Indicator
items.description: A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs

items.name: telemetry-hud
items.title: Telemetry HUD
items.description: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

items.name: terminal-simulator
items.title: Terminal Simulator
items.description: A terminal window types commands and streams log output.

items.name: testimonial-card
items.title: Testimonial Card
items.description: Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.

items.name: testimonial-proof-card
items.title: Testimonial Proof Card
items.description: A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.

variables.default: We shipped our launch video in a single afternoon

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.

items.name: text-stagger
items.title: Text Stagger
items.description: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

items.name: text-state-swap
items.title: Text State Swap
items.description: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

items.name: texture-mask-text
items.title: Texture Mask Text
items.description: CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps

items.name: three-orbiting-cards
items.title: Three Orbiting Cards
items.description: A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.

items.name: ticker-takeover
items.title: Ticker Takeover
items.description: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax

items.name: titlecard-calm
items.title: Titlecard Calm
items.description: A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.

items.name: titlecard-lockup
items.title: Titlecard Lockup
items.description: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

items.name: toggle-flip
items.title: Toggle Flip
items.description: An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.

items.name: top-down-letters
items.title: Top-Down Letters
items.description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

items.name: touch-indicator
items.title: Touch Indicator
items.description: A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass, causes a same-frame response, and lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.

items.name: tracing-beam
items.title: Tracing Beam
items.description: A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.

items.name: tracking-in
items.title: Tracking In
items.description: A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels

items.name: trust-strip
items.title: Trust Strip
items.description: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

variables.default: Northwind, Acme Corp, Globex, Initech, Umbra

items.name: type-match-cut
items.title: Type Match Cut
items.description: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

items.name: typed-prompt
items.title: Typed Prompt
items.description: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: The three-dot chat bubble that says someone is writing: it pops in at the thread's edge exactly as messaging apps do, holds while the reply is coming, and vanishes when the message lands

items.name: ui-focus-zoom
items.title: UI Focus Zoom
items.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

items.name: variable-axis-type
items.title: Variable Axis Type
items.description: A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.

items.name: variable-font-flex
items.title: Variable Font Flex
items.description: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

items.name: vector-editor-rig
items.title: Vector Editor Rig
items.description: A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.

items.name: velocity-throw-snap
items.title: Velocity Throw Snap
items.description: A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.

items.name: vignette
items.title: Vignette
items.description: Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient — darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center

items.name: vox-annotate
items.title: Vox Annotate
items.description: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

variables.default: Ship the story, not the spec

items.name: whip-pan-cut
items.title: Whip Pan Cut
items.description: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

items.name: whiteboard-ink
items.title: Whiteboard Ink
items.description: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

items.name: wordmark-tiles
items.title: Wordmark Tiles
items.description: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

items.name: x-follow-card
items.title: X Follow Card
items.description: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

items.name: yt-camera-move
items.title: Camera Punch-In
items.description: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay

items.name: yt-circle-pointer
items.title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
items.description: Draw-on annotation ellipse around a target plus a countdown chip that pulses each tick

items.name: yt-feather-highlight
items.title: Feathered Spotlight
items.description: Dims the frame except a feathered ellipse; the hole's position and size are CSS variables, so helpers glide the spotlight between targets

items.name: yt-screen-warp
items.title: On-Screen Display Effect
items.description: Grid, scanline, vignette, and sheen overlay plus a 3D-warp wrapper class that makes footage read as if playing on a physical display

items.name: zoom-through-transition
items.title: Zoom Through Transition
items.description: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.
